newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers under pressure amid poor demand.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers under pressure amid poor demand.

text.p: Singapore bunker market was directionless as quotes were notional and buyers were sidelined as they expected prices to fall, traders said on Tuesday.

They said bunker prices were under pressure on crude losses and weaker cargo prices. Some traders said they expected prices to hover around $122-$124 per tonne for 180-cst and at around $118-$120 for 380-cst, a dollar under Monday's quotes.
Enquiries were few as buyers were sidelined as they expected sellers to quote lower levels, but some sellers were unwilling to lower offers, traders said.
MDO was quoted at $205-$210 and gas oil at $215-$220.
